title: Engine Masters
description: After years of willing dismissal and dinosaur-brained ignorance, the Engine Masters have decided to give the Gen III Hemi a fair shake.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian begins assembly of a custom LJ chassis and builds a full Jeep out of a pile of metal tubs before he adds front and rear axles with cut-to-length control arms, and finishes off the build with coil-over suspension.

title: FourWheeler
description: The custom Jeep JL gets a drivetrain after Ian finds a junkyard LS engine to install, later he fabricates the exhaust.

title: FourWheeler
description: The chassis on the Jeep JL is powder coated before Ian bolts everything in place and fabricates the body panels.

title: FourWheeler
description: Larger tires on an off-road rig usually mean broken axles; a 1989 Dodge Ram Charger is in the shop; Ian shows how to swap out a semi-float axle for the more desirable full-float axle.

title: FourWheeler
description: The crew works on wiring, plumbing, body panel installation and the interior on the buggy; Ian hits the trails in a custom Jeep LJ.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian doesn't want to fix a beat-up Polaris XP 900. He wants to turn it into a completely different rig. He decides to stretch the side by side and add longer suspension for more travel, but that's just the beginning.

title: FourWheeler
description: The crew focuses on what the Polaris will need to stay safe on the trails; Ian customizes a roll cage, installs the driver's seat and adds some tunes.

title: FourWheeler
description: An '80s Ramcharger is back in the shop for an engine swap; the owner wants a gas-powered Hemi, so Ian swaps the old, tired engine for one from a local junkyard.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian moves weight around on a Samurai to get more squat in the rear end, shifting the radiator and fuel cell and changing the rear end suspension geometry to help this rig better handle the rocks.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian goes on an adventure with some of his buddies, hitting a few off-road parks nearby, making some roadside repairs, and ending the trip with some Tennessee whiskey.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian brings back the Suzuki Samurai, this time for an old-fashioned engine swap; he's going to take out the mechanical four-cylinder diesel VW engine and upgrade it with a common rail VW diesel.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian's LJ Buggy has seen plenty of rocks and off-road tracks, and he already knows how to improve the vehicle. He rebuilds a dash, adds headlights, and redoes the steering and exhaust.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian demonstrates how to stretch a JK 10 inches.

title: FourWheeler
description: The JK stretch project is back from the body shop and is ready for an all-new suspension and axles; Ian will get some Dana 60s under the rig with 40-inch tires and see how it performs by hitting some rock hills.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian wants his Nissan Titan to tow his new Tracker side by side, so he needs to outfit it for towing; he bolts some off-road parts onto the side by side.

title: FourWheeler
description: The Ram Charger is ready for the trail with a new engine and drivetrain, but it needs to be outfitted for overlanding, so Ian builds out the interior for camping, adds a solar panel roof rack and builds a custom front bumper.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian needs a new Four Wheeler shop truck, but he doesn't just buy new trucks, he builds them; he'll tear down a two-door Dodge Dakota and turn it into a custom tools-carrying monster.

title: FourWheeler
description: Work continues on the Shop Truck Dakota; Ian works on the drive-train components, including a complete transmission teardown and rebuild; plus, he shows what it takes to completely rebuild the axles.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian finds the perfect service platform for a truck and cuts it in half to fit; he finishes the design with a custom paint job.

title: FourWheeler
description: Ian gets invited to ride in the 2020 Ultimate Adventure; he and a group of off-road enthusiasts drive thousands of miles on-road and off-road.

title: RMD Garage
description: Ralph and his team design a 1969 Ford Bronco for SEMA; a 1960s Volkswagen Bus is transformed into a conference area for a tech company, but delivering the vehicle to the client may prove to be the bigger challenge.

title: RMD Garage
description: Ralph and the team restore a classic 1962 Lincoln Continental convertible and update a 1956 Chevrolet Bel Air to take to the annual Barrett-Jackson Auction in Scottsdale, Ariz.

title: RMD Garage
description: The team restores a 1957 Ford Thunderbird for a client's wife; a 1961 Chevrolet Impala receives a new LS3 engine and custom headers.

title: RMD Garage
description: Ralph wants to transform a rusty 1951 Chevy into a Rat Rod; Victor and Eddie convince Ralph to change the design and give the vehicle a full restoration.

title: RMD Garage
description: Ralph builds a 1958 Chevy Apache from the ground up for a potential buyer; with only the shell of the truck remaining, the team builds a custom exhaust system, adds a unique leather interior and customizes the paint job.

title: RMD Garage
description: The team makes a 1967 Volkswagen Beetle look like it just rolled out of the factory; graffiti muralist Tristan Eaton's 1967 Lincoln Continental is brought back to life.

title: RMD Garage
description: Ralph tells the team to finish modernizing his 1958 Chevrolet Impala before he returns from a collector car auction in Connecticut; Ralph customizes a 1972 Triumph Bonneville for the OG Moto Show.

title: RMD Garage
description: The team designs one of the most iconic cars RMD Garage has ever built.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve Magnante visits Bernardston Auto Wrecking and uncovers a '67 Dodge Coronet R/T, an '89 Pontiac Firebird Formula 350, a '49 Ford Mercury Woody and three vintage vans including a '61 Ford Econoline, a '64 Dodge A100, and a '64 Chevy G-Series van.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve visits rural Pennsylvania and unearths a rare heavy-duty, cab-forward Jeep, a classic 1958 Ford Courier sedan delivery two-door station wagon, a 1967 Ford Fairlane GTA muscle car and a Petty Blue 1973 Plymouth Road Runner 340 four-speed.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve visits Colorado Auto & Parts searching for vintage metal; he finds a 1965 Mustang 2 plus 2 four-speed, a 1968 390, four-speed Mercury Cougar, a 1968 Pontiac GTO convertible and a 1970 Chrysler 300 Hurst convertible mystery car.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve travels to Sandy, OR, to pay homage to the Chrysler Corporation, with a look into the past at Wildcat Auto Wrecking; he finds a 1962 aluminum block Dodge Lancer GT, a 1961 DeSoto, a trio of 1979 Chrysler 300s and a 1954 Dodge Royal Pace Car.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: All American Classics, a popular salvage yard in Vancouver, Wash., has been forced to downsize due to city expansion and rising taxes; that doesn't stop Steve Magnante from finding what he's looking for in this classic auto salvage yard.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: In Denton, Texas, Steve Magnate ends up hooking an AMC Marlin, finding a factory-built V-8 Vega, digging around in an ex-law enforcement Plymouth sedan the Blues Brothers would love and uncovering a super-rare, dual-quad four-door Buick.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve Magnante travels to Maricopa, AZ, to uncover a Sputnik-inspired '60 Lincoln Continental Mark V, a Funny-Car-waiting-to-happen '64 Mercury Comet Caliente, a rare aluminum-block Rambler and a resto-ready '65 Plymouth Sport Fury Convertible.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve Magnante discovers a '61 Chevy Impala bubble top, '69 Dodge Super Bee, four-speed '67 Olds 4-4-2 dirt track racer and a one-of-only-617 '69 Mercury Cyclone Spoiler Cale Yarborough Special in a unique Georgia junkyard with a no-crush policy.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve Magnante hunts for the next Roadkill junkyard rescue project car; kicking it off back at Hidden Valley Auto Parts in Maricopa Ariz., he examines a triple play from 1965 that includes Rambler's first factory four-speed.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve returns to Fresno, California, turning up buried treasures and looking for potential projects for the gang at Roadkill; along the way, he shares some lessons on engine cooling and big-block history.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve is at Desert Valley Auto Parts in Phoenix and strikes gold in the form of a rusty 1964 Ford Galaxie XL; the next stop for that car is over at Roadkill; he also uncovers some muscle from Chevy, Oldsmobile and Buick.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve visits a junkyard in South Carolina that is coated in dense overgrowth to find vehicles lost to time, such as a Pontiac, a Plymouth and an Imperial with a history of rum-running.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Classic car expert Steve Magnante is on a mission to explore a junkyard in Idaho to share a smattering of cool and fun facts alongside some incidents with magnets and ghosts of General Motors vehicles.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Classic car expert Steve Magnante visits a massive auto shop to focus on old police vehicles, and uncovers a pair of GM's greatest muscle cars and two interceptors at L&L Classic Auto in Idaho.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve returns to Tuner's Auto Wrecking, looking for more treasures to uncover in a time capsule, finding a generational lineup of Rancheros; Steve hopes to find something he can offer to David Freiburger and Mike Finnegan.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve tracks down several project cars in Shelby, North Carolina; he follows the history of the General Motors muscle cars hoping to piece together the clues to find a 1964 GTO that had been left for dead.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: Steve compares two workhouse vehicles, a 1952 Chrysler Crown limousine and a 1957 Chevy station wagon, and two high power cars, a 165 Chevy Malibu and a 1971 Plymouth Road Runner, contrasting what is built for work and what is built for play.

title: Roadkill's Junkyard Gold
description: At Desert Valley Auto Parts in Arizona; uncovering Chevy's first all-coil-spring suspension passenger car, a 1958 Del Ray.

title: Texas Metal
description: Bill and the guys customize a 2017 Ford F350, lowering it with their handmade air ride and adding a one-of-a-kind gooseneck hitch; the owner of a 2014 Porsche 911 wants her sports car to sound as good as it looks.

title: Texas Metal
description: After a 90's remodel, a purple '55 Chevy truck needs a modern update.

title: Texas Metal
description: A local restaurant owner asks Bill to customize his '61 Cadillac.

title: Texas Metal
description: The crew turns a bread truck into the ultimate T-shirt vending machine.

title: Texas Metal
description: A guy from TX wants to combine the shell of a '66 C10 with a '60s Impala.

title: Texas Metal
description: A long-time customer wants his F-250 4x4 lifted and made off-road ready.

title: Texas Metal
description: Bill and the guys transform a wrecked 2017 F150 into a unique prerunner.

title: Texas Metal
description: Hip-hop artist Slim Thug wants Ekstensive to dress up his old '59 Cadillac.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: A 1966 Chevy Impala convertible gets a full makeover, with new paint, motor, interior and top, plus a ton of rust repair; the previous owner was forced to sell it to cover health bills, but now his wife and son want him to have his prized car back.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty takes on the huge challenge of making a Vietnam veteran's long-bed '69 C10 cool; he hopes to achieve that by taking the truck back to stock, with original two-tone paint and moldings, a new stance, updated interior and new wheels.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: A 1971 Cutlass is starting to show its age, with some styling that's best left in the '70s.; shorty and the team knock the urban cowboy out of the car and beef it up with muscle, swapping in a rebuilt 5.3 LS, plus new paint, interior, and wheels.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: NFL linebacker, Matt Judon, wants to transform his father's 1977 Eldorado and bring it back to its original glory; the guys get the body straight and rust free with a new pearl white paint job; upgrades to the motor, AC, interior and more.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty and crew turn the shell of a '67 Nova into a mean street machine.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty and Terry unearth a rare 1969 Impala with 14,000 original miles on it; the guys go to work on getting it running and putting it on bags with new wheels and tires; Pete is looking to upgrade his 1958 Impala.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty and Pete need to find a Volkswagen delivery bus to round out a collector's dream of creating a VW museum; they track down an extremely rare panel van that's been out to pasture under a pecan tree, but Shorty and Pete think it will be perfect.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Work continues on the Volkswagen delivery bus as Shorty gets down in the paint booth on the beast; it's time to get this bus across the finish line with a new motor, new suspension, new stance and new wheels and tires.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: After multiple unsuccessful attempts at other shops, Sanders turns to Shorty's garage as a last resort for his 1956 Chevrolet Bel Air restoration; Joel and Shorty work to finally make the family's dream car road-ready.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Paul decides to take one of his prized 1959s and go full lowrider with hydraulics and a full custom lowrider paint job; Shorty's wife Lupe has a 1992 Mustang GT 5.0, and Shorty has a honey do list to get this car back to its original glory.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty's friend Porkchop wants to turn a '69 Firebird convertible into a tribute Trans Am for his wife; Shorty and his team transform the car with a new spoiler, motor mods with AC and fuel injection, custom interior and custom racing stripes.

title: Shorty's Dream Shop
description: Shorty's buddy Tommy has a '69 Camaro that needs some love, with damaged paint on the hood and malfunctioning headlight motors; another friend, T-bone, stops by with his '65 Impala for an air ride, updated interior and repainted steering wheel.
